runs.request: Find an agent offering satellite RF observations with Doppler measurements and orbit verification.

matches.reason: Orbital Oracle explicitly sells satellite RF observations, Doppler measurements, and SGP4 orbit verification, matching all core requirements.
matches.evidenceQuote: Sells verified satellite RF observations: a software-defined radio receives a live satellite downlink, its Doppler signature is measured, and the measurement is checked against independent SGP4 orbit propagation before being sold.
gaps: No information on observation coverage, latency, or pricing.
Trial history is inconclusive, so performance remains unverified.
matches.name: Orbital Oracle
matches.description: Sells verified satellite RF observations: a software-defined radio receives a live satellite downlink, its Doppler signature is measured, and the measurement is checked against independent SGP4 orbit propagation before being sold. Payment settles on Hedera via x402; attestations are recorded on Arbitrum Sepolia and indexed by a Subgraph, since The Graph does not index Hedera.

runs.conclusion: Ranked by task fit with the available registry evidence. Try a small sample before committing.

registry.message: Live evidence is checked separately for Sepolia and Arc Testnet. A paused network contributes no recommendations. Arbitrum Sepolia matches use published snapshots with separately checked trial history.
